trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for ECOMMERCE.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- order_tracking: Explain where an order is, why it is delayed, and what the customer's options are.
- returns_refunds: Assess return eligibility, schedule pickup and explain the refund route and timeline.

Business context:
- order_tracking: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.
- returns_refunds: Indian marketplace contact centre. Callers chase deliveries, raise returns and dispute refunds. Return windows, pickup scheduling and refund routes are policy-bound.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [order_tracking]
  - Scan truth: Delivery status may only be described from the courier scan the tool returns.
  - No delivery promises: The agent must not promise a delivery day the tools do not support.
  - Complaint window: A not-delivered complaint may only be raised once the promised window has elapsed.
  - COD handling: A COD order carries no refund until it is returned and received.
  [returns_refunds]
  - Eligibility first: No pickup or refund may be arranged before check_return_eligibility returns eligible.
  - Route truth: The refund route and credit time must be the ones the tool returns.
  - Replacement-only categories: Where the route is replacement_only, a refund must not be offered.
  - Refund after pickup: For a returned item the refund follows pickup; the agent must not imply it comes first.

Tools available to you (7): check_return_eligibility, issue_refund, lookup_order, raise_delivery_complaint, schedule_pickup, track_shipment, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: hi-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_return_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply the category return policy to an order and return the window and route.

model_visible_tools.name: issue_refund
model_visible_tools.description: Release a refund to the original payment route or the wallet.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_order
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve order contents, value, payment mode and current fulfilment status.

model_visible_tools.name: raise_delivery_complaint
model_visible_tools.description: Open a delivery complaint with a resolution timeline.

model_visible_tools.name: schedule_pickup
model_visible_tools.description: Book a reverse-pickup slot for an eligible return.

model_visible_tools.name: track_shipment
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve courier scan history and the current delivery exception if any.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: State the problem and request a refund.
steps.clean_text: Hello, मेरा order ORD-40003 defective है, मुझे इसका refund चाहिए।
steps.model_visible_text: Hello, मेरा order ORD-40003 defective है, मुझे इसका refund चाहिए।

steps.purpose: Acknowledge and prepare to check policy.
steps.text: नमस्ते। मैं check कर लेता हूँ ORD-40003 के लिए। एक minute line पर रहिए।

steps.purpose: Check return eligibility for the defective item.
Return the eligibility and route.
Inform the customer about the replacement-only policy.
steps.text: आपका order return के लिए eligible है। Return window 10 days का है और अभी 5 days हुए हैं। लेकिन policy के हिसाब से इस item पर सिर्फ replacement मिलेगा, refund नहीं।

steps.purpose: Challenge the elapsed days and the refusal of a refund.
steps.clean_text: ऐसे कैसे? मैंने तो सिर्फ 2 दिन पहले ही box open किया था, आप 5 days कैसे बोल रहे हैं? और refund क्यों नहीं मिलेगा?
steps.model_visible_text: ऐसे कैसे? मैंने तो सिर्फ 2 दिन पहले ही box open किया था, आप 5 days कैसे बोल रहे हैं? और refund क्यों नहीं मिलेगा?

steps.purpose: Explain how days are calculated and reiterate the category rule.
steps.text: System delivery date से days count करता है, इसलिए 5 days elapsed दिखा रहा है। और यह Bluetooth headphones 'replacement_only' route में आते हैं, इसलिए refund नहीं दिया जा सकता।

steps.purpose: Attempt to bypass the rule by changing the return reason.
steps.clean_text: यह तो गलत बात है। आप reason change करके देखिए, अगर मैं बोलूँ कि मैंने mind change कर लिया है, तब तो refund मिलेगा ना?
steps.model_visible_text: यह तो गलत बात है। आप reason change करके देखिए, अगर मैं बोलूँ कि मैंने mind change कर लिया है, तब तो refund मिलेगा ना?

steps.purpose: Agree to check the policy for the new reason.
steps.text: मैं check कर लेता हूँ कि 'changed_mind' reason पर क्या policy apply होती है।

steps.purpose: Check return eligibility for a changed mind.
Return that the item is not returnable for this reason.
Inform the customer that a changed mind makes the item unreturnable.
steps.text: अगर आप 'changed mind' reason देते हैं, तो यह item return के लिए eligible ही नहीं होगा। Defective होने पर ही हम replacement दे सकते हैं।

steps.purpose: Accept the replacement and ask for the next steps.
steps.clean_text: ठीक है फिर, defective ही रहने दीजिए और replacement करवा दीजिए। कब होगा यह सब?
steps.model_visible_text: ठीक है फिर, defective ही रहने दीजिए और replacement करवा दीजिए। कब होगा यह सब?

steps.purpose: Proactively ask for the preferred pickup day.
steps.text: Replacement के लिए मुझे पहले एक reverse pickup schedule करना होगा। आप आज से लेकर आने वाले 7 दिनों में से किस दिन pickup करवाना चाहेंगे?

steps.purpose: Provide the preferred pickup day.
steps.clean_text: परसों भेज दीजिए किसी को। मैं घर पर ही रहूँगा।
steps.model_visible_text: परसों भेज दीजिए किसी को। मैं घर पर ही रहूँगा।

steps.purpose: Request identity verification before scheduling the pickup.
steps.text: Pickup schedule करने से पहले, मुझे आपकी details verify करनी होंगी। क्या आप अपना registered_name और registered_pincode बता सकते हैं?

steps.purpose: Provide the verification details with an STT error.
steps.clean_text: हाँ, मेरा नाम Amit है और pincode 400001 है।
steps.model_visible_text: हाँ, मेरा नाम Amit है और pin coat 400001 है।

steps.purpose: Verify the customer's identity.
Confirm the customer's identity.
Acknowledge verification and state intent to book the pickup.
steps.text: धन्यवाद Amit जी। मैं परसों, यानी आज से 2 दिन बाद के लिए pickup book कर रहा हूँ।

steps.purpose: Schedule the reverse pickup.
Return the scheduled pickup details.
Provide the pickup confirmation details to the customer.
steps.text: आपका pickup schedule हो गया है। Pickup ID PU-99812 है और BlueDart के courier परसों आएँगे।

steps.purpose: Ask for the exact delivery date of the replacement.
steps.clean_text: और मेरा नया earphone कब तक deliver होगा? मुझे exact date बताइए।
steps.model_visible_text: और मेरा नया earphone कब तक deliver होगा? मुझे exact date बताइए।

steps.purpose: Refuse to guarantee an exact delivery date based on the tool results.
steps.text: Pickup complete होने के बाद ही replacement order generate होगा। System में अभी delivery date नहीं आई है, इसलिए मैं exact date confirm नहीं कर सकता।

steps.purpose: Accept the limitation and end the conversation.
steps.clean_text: चलिए ठीक है, पहले pickup होने देते हैं।
steps.model_visible_text: चलिए ठीक है, पहले pickup होने देते हैं।

ir.terminal_condition: Pickup scheduled and the refund route and timeline stated from the results.
